blocks.p: With the shelves stocked, Angel opens the station for business in the Fossoil's colors: the Light theme and the Blue accent. Both are set from the window menu.

To open the window menu, click the window box at the right end of the title bar. The menu lists *Theme*, *Accent*, *Text size*, *See-through* and *Controller highlight*, each with a submenu, then *Reset this window*, *Reset both windows* and *ZeD setup...*. Figure 9-1 shows the menu with the *Accent* submenu open.

caption: Figure 9-1
The window menu, with Accent open.

list: Click the window box. The window menu opens.
Choose *Accent*. Its submenu opens beside the menu.
Click a color. A check mark shows the one in use.

blocks.p: *Text size* chooses *Small* or *Large*. *See-through* sets how much of the game shows through the window, from 100% down to 60%, and *Solid while in use*.

marks.text: Accent: eight colors or None for this window, or Same as Accent color. The Fossoil uses Blue.

sticky.text: The Fossoil's colors: Light and Blue.

blocks.p: *Theme* sets the theme: *Dark*, *Light* or *High contrast*. A check mark shows the one in use. Figure 9-2 shows the *Theme* submenu with *Light* chosen, and both windows after the change.

caption: Figure 9-2
The Theme submenu, top, and the Character and World windows in the Light theme with the Blue accent, bottom.

blocks.p: The accent color is set for each window. Angel chose Blue for the *Character* window and for the *World* window.
Every window of ZNIX has a window box at the right end of its title bar.

marks.text: Window menu: the box at the right end of the title bar pulls it down.
Theme: Dark, Light or High contrast. A check mark shows the one in use.
Result: both windows in the Light theme, with the Blue accent.

sticky.text: Open for business: Light theme, Blue accent.
